items.title: Bill Mays interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 5, 2025
items.q: Rosemary Clooney’s pianist, Paul Moore, got sick and couldn’t make the gig in Australia.

ctx.x: That qualifies as a train wreck to me.

I’ll tell you – it wasn’t a train wreck, this was a real learning experience about being prepared. I was very young, Rosemary Clooney’s pianist, Paul Moore, got sick and couldn’t make the gig in Australia. And I got the call, through her drummer. And I’d never worked with a big band. And I hadn’t worked with that many singers. And I didn’t think, I just didn’t know, and nobody told me, call their office and get the scores to the big band charts that you’re going to be playing and you’re going to be counting and…
Yeah, I’ll bet it never happened to you again.
